articles.title: Risk-on sentiment keeps stocks supported as US Dollar faces more pressure
articles.expand: Global equity markets remain well supported as easing US inflation continues to reinforce expectations that the Federal Reserve will leave interest rates unchanged. Technology and AI-related stocks are once again leading the advance, keeping the market firmly in a risk-on environment.

articles.title: EUR/USD reacts to data: Fed rate hike expectations fall

articles.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Hawkish ECB prospects support Euro
articles.expand: The Euro (EUR) trades 0.17% higher at around 1.1550 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Friday. The major currency pair gains as the Euro rises due to firm expectations that the European Central Bank (ECB) will raise interest rates in the policy meeting in September.

articles.expand: The Bank of Japan (BoJ) is set to raise interest rates as soon as September and is likely to hike more aggressively thereafter from the current pace of roughly twice a year, three sources familiar with its thinking told Reuters.

The sources noted that "an early rate hike has come into sight", adding that the BOJ "could also accelerate the pace of rate increases".
